title: A preconceptional stress model identifies thalamostriatal substrates of intergenerational vulnerability
title_zh: 产前压力模型识别胰岛体纹状体亚型的代际脆弱性
abstract: Abstract Antenatal depression affects up to 20% of pregnancies worldwide and is associated with increased neuropsychiatric vulnerability in offspring, yet the enduring behavioural, neuroanatomical, and molecular features associated with maternal mood disturbance remain incompletely characterized. T o model depression that begins before conception, female mice were subjected to social-isolation rearing (SIR) from weaning through gestation and lactation, and behavioural, neuroanatomical, and molecular outcomes were assessed in adult offspring of both sexes. Offspring of SIR dams exhibited robust anxiety-like behaviours across multiple paradigms. High-resolution ex vivo structural magnetic resonance imaging revealed reduced relative volumes of the thalamus and striatum, together with relative expansion of gustatory/visceral and visual cortices. Multivariate analyses identified a pattern of thalamostriatal and other regional volume differences that covaried with behavioural impairment. Diffusion tensor imaging further identified region-specific elevations in fractional anisotropy, consistent with persistent differences in brain microstructure. Transcriptomic profiling of the thalamus revealed widespread, sex-dependent differences in gene expression, implicating pathways related to synaptic organization, protein synthesis, neuronal plasticity, and myelination. Exploratory DNA-methylation analyses identified nominal, sex-dependent pathway enrichments that did not survive false-discovery-rate correction. Together, these findings show that maternal stress beginning before pregnancy leaves a persistent imprint on offspring brain structure, microstructure, and epigenetic regulation, converging on the thalamus as a central hub of intergenerational vulnerability. This work establishes SIR as a translationally relevant model of depression that predates conception and provides integrated MRI- and molecular-level biomarkers for dissecting mechanisms and informing early preventive strategies.
abstract_zh: 摘要 产前抑郁影响全球20%的妊娠，并与后代神经精神脆弱性增加相关，然而与母体情绪累积相关的持久行为、神经解剖和分子特征仍未完全阐明。为模拟在受孕前开始的抑郁，雌性小鼠在断奶至妊娠和哺乳期间接受社会隔离饲养（SIR），并评估两性成年后代的行为、神经解剖和分子结果。SIR产后代在多种范式中表现出强烈的焦虑样行为。高分辨率体外结构磁共振成像显示，纹状体和丘脑相对体积减小，而味觉/内脏和视觉皮层相对体积扩大。多变量分析确定了一种纹状体丘脑和其他区域体积差异的模式，该模式与行为障碍相关。扩散张量成像进一步确定了区域特异性的分数上升，提示持久的脑微观结构差异。丘脑转录组分析揭示了广泛的、性依赖性的基因表达差异，涉及突触组织、蛋白合成、神经可塑性和髓鞘化等通路。探索性DNA甲基化分析确定了假阳性通路富集，未在假发现率校正后存活。综上，这些发现表明，在妊娠前开始的母体压力会在后代大脑结构、微观结构和表观遗传调控中留下持久印记，汇聚于丘脑，成为代际脆弱性的中心枢纽。这项工作确立了社会隔离饲养作为一种在受孕前即相关的抑郁转化模型，并提供了用于解析机制和指导早期预防策略的整合MRI和分子级生物标志物。
